Access freee's full product suite—Accounting, HR, Invoicing, Sales, and Project Management—through natural conversation. Draft journal entries, automate data registration, and get instant analysis of your business data. Generate financial reports in freee Accounting, calculate complex payroll allowances in freee HR, import spreadsheet-based estimates into freee Invoicing, compute client margins in freee Sales, or log work hours in freee Project Management—all by simply describing what you need. Turn everyday back-office tasks into effortless conversations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add freee to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add freee to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.freee.co.jp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the freee MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: freee lists 13 MCP tools, including freee_api_delete, freee_api_get, freee_api_list_paths, freee_api_patch, freee_api_post, freee_api_put, freee_auth_status, freee_clear_auth, freee_current_user, freee_get_current_company, freee_list_companies, and freee_server_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to freee?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to freee in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
freee requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
freee is developed by freee K.K.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
